description: A standalone Python script for testing the Krisp VIVA noise reduction filter on real audio files. It reads an input audio file, applies the filter, and saves the processed output, with options for noise suppression level and frame duration.

classes.name: KrispVivaFilter
classes.description: A filter class for Krisp VIVA noise reduction, imported from pipecat.audio.filters.krisp_viva_filter

methods.name: validate_model_path
methods.description: Checks that the KRISP_VIVA_FILTER_MODEL_PATH environment variable is set and points to an existing file

methods.name: process_audio_file
methods.description: Asynchronously processes an input audio file through Krisp VIVA filter and saves the output

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the script, parses arguments and initiates audio processing
